question: Contá los posibles venteos satelitales desde enero de 2024, dentro de concesiones, que están adentro de un área protegida del IGN.

attempts.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lon AS px, lat AS py FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado
  WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND lon IS NOT NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL
),
c_rings AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion AS pid, r.ring, r.rid
  FROM sig_energia.concesion c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.anillo::jsonb AS j) jj
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(jj.j->0->0) = 'array' THEN jj.j ELSE jsonb_build_array(jj.j) END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY r(ring, rid)
  WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL AND c.anillo <> ''
),
a_rings AS (
  SELECT a.gid AS pid, r.ring, r.rid
  FROM ign.area_protegida a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.anillos::jsonb AS j) jj
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(jj.j->0->0) = 'array' THEN jj.j ELSE jsonb_build_array(jj.j) END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY r(ring, rid)
  WHERE a.anillos IS NOT NULL AND a.anillos <> ''
),
c_pts AS (
  SELECT pid, rid, p.n, (p.v->>0)::float8 x, (p.v->>1)::float8 y,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pid, rid) cnt
  FROM c_rings, jsonb_array_elements(ring) WITH ORDINALITY p(v, n)
),
a_pts AS (
  SELECT pid, rid, p.n, (p.v->>0)::float8 x, (p.v->>1)::float8 y,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pid, rid) cnt
  FROM a_rings, jsonb_array_elements(ring) WITH ORDINALITY p(v, n)
),
c_edges AS (
  SELECT a.pid, a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2
  FROM c_pts a JOIN c_pts b ON a.pid = b.pid AND a.rid = b.rid AND b.n = a.n % a.cnt + 1
),
a_edges AS (
  SELECT a.pid, a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2
  FROM a_pts a JOIN a_pts b ON a.pid = b.pid AND a.rid = b.rid AND b.n = a.n % a.cnt + 1
),
c_bbox AS (SELECT pid, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM c_pts GROUP BY pid),
a_bbox AS (SELECT pid, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM a_pts GROUP BY pid),
in_c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.gml_id, v.px, v.py
  FROM v JOIN c_bbox b ON v.px BETWEEN b.minx AND b.maxx AND v.py BETWEEN b.miny AND b.maxy
  JOIN c_edges e ON e.pid = b.pid
  GROUP BY v.gml_id, v.px, v.py, b.pid
  HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (e.y1 > v.py) <> (e.y2 > v.py)
                   AND v.px < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (v.py - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) % 2 = 1
),
in_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.gml_id
  FROM in_c v JOIN a_bbox b ON v.px BETWEEN b.minx AND b.maxx AND v.py BETWEEN b.miny AND b.maxy
  JOIN a_edges e ON e.pid = b.pid
  GROUP BY v.gml_id, v.px, v.py, b.pid
  HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (e.y1 > v.py) <> (e.y2 > v.py)
                   AND v.px < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (v.py - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) % 2 = 1
)
SELECT count(*) FROM in_a

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.anillo::jsonb AS j) jj
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(

  ) WITH ORDINALITY r(ring, rid)
  WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL AND c.anillo <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'a', a.gid, r.ring, r.rid
  FROM ign.area_protegida a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.anillos::jsonb AS j) jj
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(jj.j->0->0) = 'array' THEN jj.j ELSE jsonb_build_array(jj.j) END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY r(ring, rid)
  WHERE a.anillos IS NOT NULL AND a.anillos <> ''
),
pts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT kind, pid, rid, p.n, (p.v->>0)::float8 x, (p.v->>1)::float8 y,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, pid, rid) cnt
  FROM rings, jsonb_array_elements(ring) WITH ORDINALITY p(v, n)
),
edges AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT a.kind, a.pid, a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2
  FROM pts a JOIN pts b ON a.kind = b.kind AND a.pid = b.pid AND a.rid = b.rid AND b.n = a.n % a.cnt + 1
  WHERE a.y <> b.y
),
eb AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*, g AS band
  FROM edges e, generate_series(floor(least(e.y1, e.y2) * 10)::int, floor(greatest(e.y1, e.y2) * 10)::int) g
),
cross_cnt AS (
  SELECT v.gml_id, eb.kind, eb.pid, count(*) AS n
  FROM v JOIN eb ON eb.band = v.band

  GROUP BY v.gml_id, eb.kind, eb.pid
),
inside AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gml_id, kind FROM cross_cnt WHERE n % 2 = 1
)
